description: Widening and Improvement of the Road Section surrounding Vavuniya town of the Kandy-Jaffna Road (A9)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Under the Widening and Improvement Programme for National Highways, bids have been invited following the national competitive procurement method to select a contractor for the widening and improvement of the road section of 3km of the Kandy-Jaffna Road (A9), spanning from ch.176+000 Km to ch. 179+000 Km passing through the Vavuniya town. Seven (07) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation of the High-Level Procurement Committee following an evaluation of the said bids, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to award the said contract to M/s Kanwel Constructions & Civil Engineering (Pvt) Ltd, the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of Rs.1,318.3 million (excluding Value Added Tax), was approved by the Cabinet.
